shelters.name: Columbus Humane
shelters.description: Advancing animal welfare since 1883. Works with over 8,000 animals and thousands more people annually. Responds to reports of animal cruelty and neglect.

shelters.name: Ohio SPCA
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) dedicated to rescuing, rehoming, and rehabilitating animals. Animal Shelter houses up to 300 cats and 80 dogs. Farm Sanctuary with 50+ rescued farm animals.

shelters.name: Rescue Village
shelters.description: Humane society serving Cleveland area's eastern communities. Partners with 45+ shelters and rescues regionally. Helps around 3,000 animals annually.

shelters.name: PAWS Ohio
shelters.description: Founded 1976, 501(c)(3) no-kill organization. One of Ohio's most reputable cat and dog rescue groups. Foster-based rescue - no physical shelter.

shelters.name: Northeast Ohio SPCA
shelters.description: No-kill pet shelter and clinic. No-kill, nonprofit private agency receiving no government funding.

shelters.name: Toledo Humane Society
shelters.description: Hundreds of dogs, cats, puppies, kittens, and pocket pets looking for homes. All animals receive medical exam, vaccines, microchip, and spay/neuter before adoption.

shelters.name: Summit County Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane Society of Greater Akron serving Summit County and the Akron area.

shelters.name: One of a Kind Pet Rescue
shelters.description: Nearly 100% of animals rescued from euthanasia. All spayed/neutered and current on vaccinations before adoption.

shelters.name: Haven for Pets
shelters.description: All volunteer animal rescue group helping dogs and cats in Summit County, Ohio.

shelters.name: CHA Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Animal shelter serving the Columbus area with cats and dogs available for adoption.

shelters.name: Stop The Suffering Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Columbus-based nonprofit rescuing dogs and cats from high kill shelters, primarily in Ohio, and transporting them to safety.

shelters.name: Cuyahoga County Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Provides temporary home to lost or stray dogs. Dog licensing authority for Cuyahoga County.

shelters.name: League for Animal Welfare
shelters.description: Animal welfare organization serving the Cincinnati area with adoption and rescue services.

shelters.name: Clermont Animal CARE Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Clermont County in the greater Cincinnati area.

shelters.name: Cleveland Animal Protective League
shelters.description: Animal protective league serving Cleveland with separate services for admissions, adoptions, and spay-neuter.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Ohio animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. Columbus Humane has served since 1883. PAWS Ohio founded 1976. Ohio SPCA operates shelter and farm sanctuary. Coverage spans Columbus, Cleveland, Cincinnati, Toledo, Akron, and surrounding areas.
